releaseNotes:
• Prominent Sinhala Phonetic Keyboard: High-visibility bold Sinhala letters (18.5sp) displayed as primary key glyphs with subtle Latin phonetic hints
• Guaranteed Lowercase Sinhala Entry: Sinhala mode always opens in clean simple lowercase, preventing accidental CapsLock shifts
• Dedicated Kaomoji Hub: 105+ high-expressivity Japanese kaomojis separated into their own dedicated panel tab without polluting emojis or unicode symbols
• Worldwide Complete Emoji & Ancient Glyph Library: Full worldwide standard emojis and 20,000+ ancient unicode glyphs organized seamlessly
• Streamlined WhatsApp Status Saver: 100% dedicated to WhatsApp statuses with direct saving to Pictures/PS_Board_Statuses
• Zero-Telemetry On-Device Bug & Crash Diagnostics: Instant diagnostic capture with user-controlled 1-tap WhatsApp/Email issue reporting
